cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen displays all captions, fields and the function-key legend
cases.steps:
1. Enter transaction OD02 (or select Account Update from the menu)
2. Observe the initial screen
cases.expected: The header shows Tran: OD02, the title 『ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM』, the current date and time, and Pgm: ODACCTU. The captions Account ID, Status, Credit Lim, Cash Lim, Expiry and Group ID are shown with empty entry fields. The message line shows 『Enter account id and press ENTER to fetch.』 and the legend 『ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear』 (PF5 is not listed although it is the save key).
cases.remark: U1 · §2.1 MACCTUA · 1000-SEND-INITIAL L60-71 · map MACCTU · msg#1 · trap#1 PF5 not on legend

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Fetched account detail is rendered in the editable fields
cases.steps:
1. On the initial screen type Account ID = 00000000001
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The screen shows the current values of account 00000000001 — Status Y, Credit Lim 5,000.00, Cash Lim 1,000.00, Expiry 2027-03-31, Group ID GOLD — in the editable fields, and the message line shows 『Amend fields and press PF5 to update.』
cases.remark: U1 · 2100-FETCH-ACCT L108-113 · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL L235-242 · msg#2

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the entry fields are empty and the header is auto-populated
cases.steps:
1. Enter transaction OD02 as the first interaction (no prior commarea)
2. Observe the fields and header
cases.expected: All six entry fields are blank (cleared to low-values). The header is auto-filled by the program: Tran OD02, Pgm ODACCTU, title 『ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM』, and the current date and time from the CICS clock. The message line prompts 『Enter account id and press ENTER to fetch.』
cases.remark: U2 · 1000-SEND-INITIAL MOVE LOW-VALUES · 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · 8500-GET-DATE-TIME ASKTIME/FORMATTIME · msg#1

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: After a successful fetch the fields hold the loaded values and stay editable
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000002 and press ENTER
2. Inspect the six fields
cases.expected: The mode switches to update: the fields show account 00000000002's values (Status Y, Credit Lim 10,000.00, Cash Lim 2,000.00, Expiry 2028-06-30, Group ID PLATINUM) and remain enterable so the operator can amend them. The program does not protect the fields after fetch/save.
cases.remark: U3 · mode flag F→U CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) · item-states §2.1 · trap#2 fields stay UNPROT

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Credit and cash limits are shown with a thousands-separator edit mask
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000004 and press ENTER
2. Read the Credit Lim and Cash Lim fields
cases.expected: Credit Lim shows 25,000.00 and Cash Lim shows 5,000.00 — formatted with comma grouping and two decimals by the display edit mask, not as raw digits.
cases.remark: U4 · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL L237-240 · WS-ED-AMT edit mask -,---,---,--9.99

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: ENTER key fetches the keyed account (Process)
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000005
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The account is fetched from the account master (ORION.ACCT) by key and its values are displayed; the message line shows 『Amend fields and press PF5 to update.』
cases.remark: U6 · EIBAID=DFHENTER → 2100-FETCH-ACCT L81-82 · msg#2

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Account Update screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3
cases.expected: The transaction cancels and control transfers to the main menu (OCMENU); the Account Update screen is left.
cases.remark: U6/U7 · EIBAID=DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU · XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) L252

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the screen and restarts entry
cases.precondition: F-STD. A row for account 00000000001 has been fetched (mode = update).
cases.steps: 1. With account 00000000001 loaded, press PF4
cases.expected: All entry fields are cleared, the mode resets to fetch, and the message line returns to 『Enter account id and press ENTER to fetch.』
cases.remark: U6/U15 · EIBAID=DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L79-80 · mode U→F · msg#1

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF5 saves the amended account (save key not shown on the legend)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000000001 has been fetched (mode = update).
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Change Credit Lim to 6,000.00
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: Even though PF5 is absent from the on-screen legend, it is the save key: the change is written to the account master and the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』
cases.remark: U6 · EIBAID=DFHPF5 → 2200-UPDATE-ACCT L83-84 · trap#1 · msg#5

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry keeps the operator on the transaction
cases.steps:
1. Enter OD02 (first interaction) → initial screen
2. Type Account ID = 00000000001 and press ENTER → detail screen
3. Observe the transaction stays OD02 between interactions
cases.expected: The first interaction shows the initial screen; each subsequent key is processed against the same transaction (returns with transaction id OD02) — first-entry versus re-entry is tracked in the commarea, so the screen state carries across interactions.
cases.remark: U7 · 0000-MAIN EIBCALEN/CA-FIRST-ENTER · 9000-RETURN TRANSID(OD02) · CA-PGM-CONTEXT

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: End-to-end: fetch, amend credit limit, save
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000001, press ENTER
2. Change Credit Lim to 8,000.00
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The account master row for 00000000001 has its credit limit set to 8,000.00; the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』
cases.remark: U8 · 2100→2300→3100-UPDATE-ACCT · UPDATE ORION.ACCT SET AC_CREDIT_LIMIT WHERE AC_ID · msg#5

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Update status to N (deactivate an active account)
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Change Status to N
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The row's active status is set to N; the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』 (no active-status gate blocks the change).
cases.remark: U8 classifier=N · 2300-EDIT-INPUT status check · UPDATE AC_ACTIVE_STATUS · msg#5

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Update status to Y (reactivate an inactive account)
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000003 with ENTER
2. Change Status to Y
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The inactive account is fetched and its status set to Y; the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』 — trap #5: an inactive account can be fetched and updated.
cases.remark: U8 classifier=Y · trap#5 no active gate · UPDATE AC_ACTIVE_STATUS · msg#5

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Update expiry date and group id (free-form fields)
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000002 with ENTER
2. Change Expiry to 2031-12-31 and Group ID to SILVER
3. Press PF5
cases.data: Account ID = 00000000002; Expiry = 2031-12-31; Group ID = SILVER
cases.expected: The expiry date becomes 2031-12-31 and the group id becomes SILVER; the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』 — neither field is format-checked, so both are stored as entered.
cases.remark: U8 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT no check on ACEXPI/ACGRPI L179-180 · UPDATE AC_EXPIRY_DATE/AC_GROUP_ID · msg#5

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Fetch-only: display current values without changing anything
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000004, press ENTER
2. Read the values, do not press PF5
cases.expected: The current values of account 00000000004 (Status Y, Credit Lim 25,000.00, Cash Lim 5,000.00, Expiry 2029-11-30, Group ID PLATINUM) are shown for review; no row is written because PF5 was not pressed.
cases.remark: U8 · 2100-FETCH-ACCT only, no UPDATE · msg#2

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Credit/cash limits with commas and decimals are parsed correctly
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000005 with ENTER
2. Enter Credit Lim = 12,500.50 and Cash Lim = 2,000.00
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The typed strings are converted to numeric amounts (credit 12500.50, cash 2000.00) and stored; the message line shows 『Account updated successfully.』
cases.remark: U9 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT COMPUTE FUNCTION NUMVAL(ACCRLIMI/ACCSLIMI) L177-178

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Save updates only the five editable columns; the rest are preserved
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000000001 has balance 1,234.56 and open date 2019-03-15.
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Change Credit Lim to 9,000.00
3. Press PF5
4. Re-fetch account 00000000001
cases.expected: Only status, credit limit, cash limit, expiry and group id are written by key. The current balance (1,234.56), open date (2019-03-15), reissue date, cycle credit/debit and zip are unchanged — they are never part of the save.
cases.remark: U11 · UPDATE ORION.ACCT SET (5 cols) WHERE AC_ID L223 · AC_CURR_BAL/AC_OPEN_DATE/AC_REISSUE_DATE/AC_CYC_*/AC_ADDR_ZIP preserved

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-saving the same values twice is idempotent
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000005 with ENTER
2. Press PF5 (no field changed)
3. Press ENTER to re-fetch, then press PF5 again
cases.expected: Each PF5 returns 『Account updated successfully.』 and the row holds the same values after both saves — repeating the save produces no additional change.
cases.remark: U11/U15 · UPDATE by key idempotent · SQLCODE 0 both times · msg#5

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: DB2 account access and menu hand-off
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000002 and press ENTER (reads the account master)
2. Press PF3
cases.expected: The account is read from the account master table (ORION.ACCT) by key on ENTER and would be written back on PF5; PF3 hands control to the main menu (OCMENU). No date/analytics/statement sub-program is called — the date and time come from the CICS clock.
cases.remark: U18 · SELECT/UPDATE ORION.ACCT · XCTL OCMENU · trap#3 no OUANLIN/OUDATE/OUSTMIN LINK

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: ENTER with a blank Account ID is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Leave Account ID blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The fetch is rejected and the message line shows 『Please enter all required fields.』; no row is read.
cases.remark: U5 · 2100-FETCH-ACCT L100-101 (ACCTIDI = SPACES/LOW-VALUES) · WS-MSG-REQUIRED · msg#12

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: ENTER with a non-numeric Account ID is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 0000000000X (contains a letter)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The fetch is rejected and the message line shows 『Account id must be numeric.』; no row is read.
cases.remark: U5 · 2100-FETCH-ACCT L118-119 (ACCTIDI not NUMERIC) · msg#3

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: PF5 save with a blank/non-numeric Account ID is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. A row has been fetched (mode = update).
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Blank out (or corrupt to 0000000000X) the Account ID field
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The update edit rejects the entry and the message line shows 『Account id is required and numeric.』; no row is written.
cases.remark: U5 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT L156-157 (ACCTIDI = SPACES or not NUMERIC) · msg#6

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: PF5 save with Status other than Y or N is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Change Status to X
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The update is rejected and the message line shows 『Status must be Y or N.』; no row is written.
cases.remark: U5 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT L161-164 (ACSTATI not Y/N) · msg#7

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: PF5 save with a blank Credit or Cash limit is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Blank out the Credit Lim field
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The update is rejected and the message line shows 『Credit and cash limits are required.』; no row is written.
cases.remark: U5 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT L168-170 (ACCRLIMI/ACCSLIMI = SPACES) · msg#8

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: PF5 pressed before any fetch is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. Fresh initial screen, no row fetched (mode = fetch).
cases.steps:
1. On the initial screen type Account ID = 00000000001
2. Press PF5 without pressing ENTER first
cases.expected: Because no row has been fetched, the save is blocked and the message line shows 『Press ENTER to fetch a row before PF5.』
cases.remark: U6/U13 · 2200-UPDATE-ACCT L133-134 (NOT MODE-UPDATE) mode gate · msg#4

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: ENTER with a non-existent Account ID reports not found
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000099 (not in the table)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The lookup returns no row (SQLCODE 100) and the message line shows 『Record not found.』
cases.remark: U13 · 2100-FETCH-ACCT L114-115 · 3000-READ-ACCT SQLCODE 100 · WS-MSG-NOTFND · msg#13 (fetch trigger)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected and the screen is re-initialised
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Press PF7 (an unsupported key)
cases.expected: The message line shows 『Invalid key pressed. Please try again.』, the screen is re-initialised (fields cleared, mode reset to fetch), and the previously loaded data is lost.
cases.remark: U6/U13 · 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN OTHER L85-88 · 1000-SEND-INITIAL then WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY · msg#11

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A DB2 error while reading the account table is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD. The account master (ORION.ACCT) returns an error SQLCODE (e.g. table in stopped state). *(needs real data)* — requires DB fault injection.
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000001
2. Press ENTER while the read returns an error SQLCODE (not 0, not 100)
cases.expected: The read is treated as not found and the message line shows 『Error reading account table.』
cases.remark: U13 · 3000-READ-ACCT WHEN OTHER L206-208 · msg#9 · needs SQL fault injection

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A DB2 error while updating the account table is reported
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000000001 fetched (mode = update). The save returns an error SQLCODE (not 0, not 100). *(needs real data)* — requires DB fault injection.
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Press PF5 while the update returns an error SQLCODE (e.g. -911)
cases.expected: The save fails and the message line shows 『Error updating account table.』; the row is not changed.
cases.remark: U13 · 3100-UPDATE-ACCT WHEN OTHER L229-231 · msg#10 · needs SQL fault injection

cases.mid: 排他・同時実行 (Exclusion / concurrent access)
cases.name: Account deleted between fetch and save reports not found on update
cases.precondition: F-STD. Account 00000000005 fetched (mode = update). Another transaction deletes account 00000000005 from the account master before PF5.
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000005 with ENTER
2. (Concurrently) account 00000000005 is deleted from ORION.ACCT
3. Change Credit Lim to 3,000.00 and press PF5
cases.expected: The save matches no row (SQLCODE 100) and the message line shows 『Record not found.』; nothing is written.
cases.remark: U12 · 2200-UPDATE-ACCT L142/145-146 · 3100-UPDATE-ACCT SQLCODE 100 · msg#13 (update trigger)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Account ID at the full 11-digit width is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000005 (all 11 digits)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 11-digit key is accepted as numeric and account 00000000005 is fetched; the message line shows 『Amend fields and press PF5 to update.』
cases.remark: U14 · ACCTIDI X(11) full width · 2100-FETCH-ACCT numeric ok · msg#2

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Account ID shorter than 11 digits is treated as non-numeric
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 12345 (5 digits, left-justified)
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Account ID = 12345 (padded with trailing spaces to 11)
cases.expected: The field is space-padded to 11 characters, so the numeric test fails and the message line shows 『Account id must be numeric.』 — the operator must key all 11 digits (e.g. 00000000001).
cases.remark: U14/U5 · ACCTIDI X(11) trailing spaces not NUMERIC · 2100 L118-119 · msg#3

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Status accepts uppercase Y/N only; lowercase is rejected
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Set Status = y (lowercase) and press PF5
3. Then set Status = Y (uppercase) and press PF5
cases.expected: Lowercase y is rejected with 『Status must be Y or N.』; uppercase Y is accepted and 『Account updated successfully.』 is shown.
cases.remark: U14/U5 · 2300-EDIT-INPUT L161 (ACSTATI = 'Y' OR 'N') case-sensitive · msg#7 then msg#5

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Credit limit at the maximum numeric magnitude is accepted
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Set Credit Lim = 9999999999.99 (maximum magnitude)
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: The value fits the amount field (10 integer plus 2 decimal digits) and is stored; 『Account updated successfully.』 is shown.
cases.remark: U14 · AC-CREDIT-LIMIT S9(10)V99 max · ACCRLIMI X(13) · NUMVAL L177

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Non-numeric text in a limit converts to zero with no error
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000001 with ENTER
2. Set Credit Lim = ABC (non-numeric) with a non-blank Cash Lim = 1000.00
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: Because only a blank check exists, the non-numeric credit limit passes the edit, is converted to 0.00, and is stored; 『Account updated successfully.』 is shown — there is no numeric validation on the limits beyond the blank check.
cases.remark: U9/U14 · 2300 only SPACES check L169 · COMPUTE NUMVAL(ABC)=0 L177 · quirk

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Expiry and Group ID accept their full 10-character width, unvalidated
cases.steps:
1. Fetch account 00000000002 with ENTER
2. Set Expiry = 2099-12-31 and Group ID = ABCDEFGHIJ (10 chars)
3. Press PF5
cases.expected: Both 10-character values are stored as entered (no date-format or group-code check); 『Account updated successfully.』 is shown.
cases.remark: U14 · ACEXPI/ACGRPI X(10) no edit · UPDATE AC_EXPIRY_DATE/AC_GROUP_ID

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: The lowest numeric key value that is not in the table reports not found
cases.steps:
1. Type Account ID = 00000000000 (numeric, not in the table)
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 11-digit all-zeros key is numeric but matches no row (SQLCODE 100); the message line shows 『Record not found.』
cases.remark: U14/U13 · 2100 numeric branch · 3000-READ-ACCT SQLCODE 100 · msg#13
